scope: Sprint 11 Workstream 1 — national capacity, cost and architecture audit, pre-implementation baseline

supabase.note: Pro plan includes 8GB database storage before per-GB overage billing begins. Prior sprints conservatively assumed a 4,500MB ceiling without verifying the actual plan-included allocation — this audit corrects that: the real 'increases paid infrastructure' threshold is 8,192MB, not 4,500MB. The 4,500MB figure remains a reasonable internal safety margin (55% of the real ceiling) and is kept as the working assumption for Sprint 11 planning rather than being loosened, since branches may not autoscale disk independently of the parent project in ways this audit fully verified.

index larger than table — candidate for index review in WS17

local_warehouse_storage.note: All gitignored, confirmed via warehouse:check. This is disk usage on the developer's own machine, not a Supabase concern.

query_performance_baseline.method: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) run live against the branch

inner_plan_finding.plan_shape: Bitmap Heap Scan on core.dim_geography using dim_geography_type_code_idx (SAL/POA type filter), then a row-by-row ILIKE '%text%' recheck filter removing ~18k of ~18k candidate rows
inner_plan_finding.finding: No index accelerates the leading-wildcard ILIKE pattern search — currently fast enough (101ms, well under the 500ms target) only because national SAL+POA row count (~18k) is still small. This will not grow further from adding more jurisdictions' MARKET DATA (ASGS geography is already fully national since Sprint 2), so this is a stable, not worsening, cost — but is flagged as an optimisation candidate for WS17 (a pg_trgm GIN index on core.dim_geography.geography_name would convert this to an index scan).

duplicate_state_specific_code_review.finding: warehouse/scripts/sales/rebuild_nsw_snapshots_after_reconciliation.mjs and warehouse/scripts/market_intelligence/load_vic_market_intelligence_to_branch.mjs share substantial structural similarity (CTE-based snapshot builder joining sales/rent/yield/approvals/demographics/rate) but were deliberately NOT abstracted into a shared helper in Sprint 10, per the explicit 'do not rewrite working logic merely for aesthetics — refactor only where needed to support a second jurisdiction safely' instruction.
duplicate_state_specific_code_review.recommendation: Revisit this decision in Workstream 6 once a THIRD jurisdiction's snapshot-builder is needed — three independent implementations of the same CTE shape is the point at which extracting a shared warehouse/scripts/market_intelligence/build_snapshot_common.mjs helper becomes justified by real duplication, not speculative refactoring.
duplicate_state_specific_code_review.action_taken_this_workstream: none — documented only, per its own recommendation to wait for a third data point

data_retention_periods.nsw_sales_monthly_mart: full 1996-2026 history (documented over-retention from Sprint 9, not addressed — DELETE is forbidden by the project's hard rules, so this remains a client-side-filtered display concern, not a database cleanup)
data_retention_periods.vic_sales_summary: full available VPSR quarterly history (5 quarters as of Sprint 10)
data_retention_periods.vic_rental_summary: full available Homes Victoria history (103 quarters)
data_retention_periods.policy_note: No automated retention/expiry policy exists yet — old mart versions do not currently 'accumulate' because every load is an UPSERT keyed on a stable natural key, not an append-only insert, so there is no growing duplicate-version problem to solve this sprint.
